items.title: How Investors May Respond To NIKE (NKE) Ending Pou Sheng China Online Sales From 2027
items.summary: Pou Sheng International announced that Nike has already notified the group its online sales of Nike products in mainland China will fully cease from January 1, 2027, removing a channel that generated about 15% of Pou Sheng’s 2025 revenue but only a small share of its profit. Ahead of this shift, concerns over how resetting Nike’s China online marketplace and related distribution changes may weigh on earnings have become central to how investors assess the brand’s current transition.
